note: The OLG adequately covers the policy substance of FNS 1064. FNS requires status reporting households to report earned income changes only when there is a change in source, hourly rate/salary, or employment status (PT/FT). The OLG's 'Simplified Reporting – Interim Report > Verifying Earned Income at Interim Report' explicitly states clients must verify earned income changes due to 'pay per hour, salary amount, source of income, starting, stopping or changing full-time or part-time status' — a direct match to the FNS criteria. The 'Simplified Reporting – Examples > Reporting Requirements' Q&A reinforces the same list. The OLG also correctly notes that the $125 reporting threshold applies only to unearned income, consistent with FNS's earned-income-specific triggers. The OLG additionally covers BEACON procedures for processing these changes (Work Number verification, VC-1 issuance, Earnings tab updates). Steps 1-5 of FNS 1064 describe QC variance determination procedures for reviewers, not caseworker policy, and are appropriately outside the OLG's scope.
